description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Frequency once per week

Requirement You personally installed the bio-augment.

Cost 1 Vitae

Tend a bio-augment you installed to reduce its Load by 1, maintained with a weekly checkup.

Spend 10 minutes and 1 Vitae tending one bio-augment you personally installed, in yourself or an ally. Its Load contribution is reduced by 1 (minimum 0) until your next checkup. Skip a week and the reduction lapses at the start of the following week; you must re-tend it to restore it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, "Load" has no rule-element representation to reduce.
